result.title: Showing versus Doing: Teaching by Demonstration
result.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2016 (oral presentation). 12 pages, including supplementary materials
result.summary: People often learn from others' demonstrations, and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) techniques have realized this capacity in machines. In contrast, teaching by demonstration has been less well studied computationally. Here, we develop a Bayesian model for teaching by demonstration. Stark differences arise when demonstrators are intentionally teaching (i.e. showing) a task versus simply performing (i.e. doing) a task. In two experiments, we show that human participants modify their teaching behavior consistent with the predictions of our model. Further, we show that even standard IRL algorithms benefit when learning from showing versus doing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为「示范教学」建立贝叶斯模型，区分示范者是有意教学（showing）还是单纯执行任务（doing），并通过两项人类实验和 IRL 学习效果说明二者差异。
